decks.notes: The main focus of this aggro Selesnya deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures like Leatherhead, Badgermole Cub, and Pawpatch Recruit, supported by ramp cards like Llanowar Elves and Hushwood Verge. The deck also includes efficient removal cards like Seam Rip and Practiced Offense to help maintain board control. Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Brightglass Gearhulk provide additional power and evasion to close out games quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Temple Garden and Multiversal Passage ensures consistent mana fixing to support the aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off, while utilizing spells like Burst Lightning and Flow State to keep up the pressure on the opponent. Mixing in a bit of control with counterspells like Spell Pierce and bounce spells like Boomerang Basics, the deck aims to maintain board presence and tempo advantage. With efficient card draw like Opt and Sleight of Hand, as well as potential finishers like Vibrant Outburst and Stormchaser's Talent, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with counter spells and removal, while maintaining a steady aggressive presence on the board with evasive creatures. The player aims to control the tempo of the game by denying the opponent's threats and taking advantage of their own powerful creatures. By efficiently managing resources and exploiting the opponent's vulnerabilities, this deck looks to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory before they can establish their own game plan.

This Izzet Control deck focuses on card draw and resource management in order to control the game and outvalue the opponent. Using cards like Accumulate Wisdom, Jeskai Revelation, and Tablet of Discovery, the deck aims to draw cards consistently and maintain a full hand. Cards like Abandon Attachments and Combustion Technique provide removal and disruption, while Great Hall of the Biblioplex and Hallowed Fountain help with mana fixing. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Thor, God of Thunder to close out the game once the opponent has been outpaced and overwhelmed.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By using cards like Boomerang Basics and Slickshot Show-Off to control the board and Eddymurk Crab and Flow State to deal damage, the deck aims to win the game quickly. The inclusion of Opt and Sleight of Hand helps to draw into more threats, while Stormchaser's Talent and Prismari Charm provide additional removal options. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy with a mix of Islands and red mana sources.

The main idea of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain board control through spells like Burst Lightning and Boomerang Basics while creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Hydro-Man, Fluid Felon deal damage to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt for card draw and selection, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. Multiversal Passage and Riverpyre Verge provide mana fixing, allowing for efficient use of the deck's spells. The strategy focuses on tempo and aggression to secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to outlast and outvalue the opponent. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through effects like Jeskai Revelation and Tablet of Discovery, while also using efficient removal and counterspells like Essence Scatter to deal with the opponent's threats. The land base provides a good mix of colors to cast the various spells in the deck, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck in a 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle utilizing low-cost creatures and spells. The deck focuses on building a strong board presence early in the game and applying continuous pressure to the opponent, limiting their options and forcing them to play defensively. The inclusion of cards like Ba Sing Se and Earthbender Ascension provide additional support and strategy to maintain momentum and push for a quick victory. The deck aims to outpace the opponent and maintain board control to secure a win before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements and card advantage to outlast and outmaneuver opponents. It includes a variety of spells and creatures that can remove threats, draw cards, and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With cards like Abandon Attachments and Accumulate Wisdom to generate value, and Iroh's Demonstration for additional control, this deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant position and secure victory. By efficiently managing resources and using its powerful spells, this deck aims to control the game and dictate the pace of play.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly swarm the board with efficient creatures and overwhelm the opponent with aggression. By utilizing cards that boost the power and toughness of your creatures, along with mana ramp and card draw, you can quickly build a formidable force that puts pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth ensures that even if the game goes long, you have the ability to close it out with a powerful swing.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and board wipes while simultaneously utilizing card draw and scrying effects to maintain card advantage and dig for key pieces. The variety of lands and colors allow for flexibility in casting powerful spells across different color combinations. The deck aims to outlast opponents by disrupting their strategies, managing resources efficiently, and eventually overwhelming them with powerful late-game threats and card advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back to the battlefield for powerful combos. By utilizing cards like Doomsday Excruciator and Winternight Stories, the player can strategically reanimate creatures like Emeritus of Ideation and Superior Spider-Man to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Bitter Triumph and Requiting Hex also provide additional value by disrupting the opponent's strategy. Additionally, spells like Duress and Day of Black Sun help control the opponent's hand and board to ensure the combo can be executed successfully.

The key strategy of this deck is to control the game through a mix of card draw, counterspells, and removal. By utilizing cards like Sleight of Hand, Opt, Spell Snare, and Prismari Charm, the player can carefully manage their resources and disrupt their opponent's plans. Cards like Burst Lightning and Sunderflock provide additional removal options, while Eddymurk Crab and Hearth Elemental can help stabilize the board. Winternight Stories and Colorstorm Stallion provide additional utility and resilience, allowing the player to outlast and outsmart their opponent in the long run.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to utilize low-cost spells and efficient creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The deck focuses on maintaining tempo by playing cheap spells like Burst Lightning and Opt, while also utilizing bounce effects like Boomerang Basics to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Key cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Eddymurk Crab provide additional aggression, while cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Vibrant Outburst help to pump up creatures for a finishing blow. Multiversal Passage and Shore Up offer protection and flexibility in the deck's mana base.

The main focus of this Izzet Control deck is to manipulate the game by utilizing card draw, counterspells, bounce effects, and burn spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By maintaining a balance between removal, card advantage, and win conditions, the deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through strategic plays and resource management. The combination of efficient removal spells, card draw engines, and disruptive spells allows the deck to maintain control of the game and dictate the pace of the match.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Doomsday Excruciator and Stock Up to set up the graveyard, followed by Requiting Hex and Superior Spider-Man to reanimate creatures, the deck aims to create powerful combos and finish the game in a swift manner. Strategic Betrayal and Deadly Cover-Up offer disruption and protection, while cards like Deceit and Emeritus of Ideation provide additional value and control options. This deck thrives on its ability to quickly assemble and execute its reanimation strategy.
